hook: what to actually say in your first therapy session

'i want to get better at ___.'

hook: what to do in the 10 minutes after a panic spike in a lecture hall
notes: you don't have to leave. if you can, stay where you are.
breathe in slowly through your nose, out slowly through your mouth. count to 5 each way.
name 5 things you can see. then 4 you can touch.
remind yourself: this peaks and passes. most panic attacks last 5 to 20 minutes.
after: text one person 'rough moment in class, i'm ok now.' you don't have to carry it alone.
if this keeps happening, your campus counseling center can actually help with it.
source: NHS, 'Panic disorder'; Childline, 'Coping with panic attacks'
caption:
save this so you're not googling it mid-lecture.

sources: NHS (panic disorder) and Childline (coping with panic attacks). this isn't medical advice. if it happens often, talk to a professional.

#anxiety #collegelife #mentalhealthawareness
